title: AI Fashion Reels for Clothing Try-On | AIVideosUGC
description: Make a short fashion video from one clothing photo for TikTok, Instagram, and a product page. Pick a length of 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds before you post.
h1: AI Fashion Reels That Show the Full Outfit
lead: Make a short fashion reel, a phone video, from one clothing photo, so the full outfit is easy to see in motion. An AI actor, a generated person, wears it, with a spoken voice and words on screen. Credits, what each job spends, are shown before you start.

faq.q: What is an AI fashion reel template?
faq.a: A ready try-on scene that puts one outfit in motion. You add a clothing photo, a hook (the opening line), a script (the words), and a voiceover (a spoken voice). An AI actor, a generated person, wears the outfit.

faq.q: How do I make the outfit reel?
faq.a: Upload the clothing or paste a product page link. Name one action, such as a turn or a short walk. Pick an AI actor, a size, and a length, then download.

faq.q: Why start from a photo instead of a fitting day?
faq.a: The try-on is built from the garment photo or the product link you already have. You can skip another shoot until you decide you need one.
Clothing shops, including menswear and womenswear, that need a reel, a listing, or a paid ad from one garment photo.

faq.q: Can I do this on the first try?
faq.a: Yes. Use a sharp photo of the full garment and name one action. Set captions and the spoken line before you post, and check the color against the garment.
A sharp, evenly lit photo of the full piece of clothing. A flat lay (a top-down photo), a hanger, or a mannequin can work. A product page link can be used when you do not have the file.

faq.q: What should I check before posting?
faq.a: Compare the color, the fit, and the outline with your photo. Add the real size and price in the editor. The person on screen is an AI actor, not a check of how it fits a real customer.

faq.q: Which size and length can I pick?
faq.a: Use 9:16, a tall phone shape, for TikTok and Instagram Reels. You can also pick 1:1 (square), 16:9 (wide), 4:3, or 3:4 (tall). Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. You can post to TikTok or Meta (Facebook and Instagram).

A video spends 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. Credits are what the job spends. A failed job returns those credits. Plans start at $24.50 a month. There is no free plan. The download has no watermark, nothing stamped on the file.

faq.q: Can I use it in ads, in another language, or from my own tools?
faq.a: Yes. Post it to TikTok or Meta (Facebook and Instagram). You can speak the line in another language and make several actions from the same photo. The API lets your product list start the next color. Add any note the platform asks you to show.
